Quick guide

Explore the photo survey

  1. Select a photo locationClick a numbered marker on the drawing or a photo in the register. The marker identifies where the camera was positioned.
  2. Explore the campusDrag to pan. Scroll, pinch, or use + / − to zoom. Fit returns to the whole drawing.
  3. Find a referenceSearch by photo ID, filename or notes. Use the filters to show attached photos or name-only locations. On a phone, use Points to open the register.
View-only copy. This website has no editing or upload controls. New survey issues are published by the project owner.
Drawing reference. Positions are manual image references, not surveyed coordinates. North and scale have not been verified. Direction arrows are clockwise from the top of the drawing.
Public information. Anyone able to open this public website can also save its drawing, photos and notes. View-only does not prevent copying.
